inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Snake Keylogger PowerShell Download and Execute

properties.description: Detects a PowerShell command line pattern used by Snake Keylogger to download and execute a payload. This pattern involves using Invoke-WebRequest to fetch a file and Start-Process to run it, often with parameters to hide the execution window. The rule also looks for execution from a temporary directory, a common malware technique.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Snake Keylogger PowerShell Download and Execute
properties.query:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("Invoke-WebRequest", "Start-Process", "-OutFile")
    and (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("-WindowStyle", "Hidden") or ProcessCommandLine has "-w hidden")
    and ProcessCommandLine has "-NoProfile"
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @'(\$env:TEMP|\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\[\w-]+\.exe)'
| project
    Timestamp,
    DeviceName,
    AccountName,
    FileName,
    ProcessCommandLine,
    InitiatingProcessFileName,
    InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
    DeviceId
